Send the proforma as PDF

WhatsAppSave PDF + open chat EmailSave PDF + open Gmail draft

WhatsApp and email links cannot carry an attachment. Each button saves the PDF first and opens the message with the proforma summary, so you attach the saved file with the paperclip. In the Claude iPhone app the save opens the share sheet, where you can send the PDF to WhatsApp or Mail directly.
